## 開篇固定收益觀點

8月5日美債收盤打斷前一交易日的全面漲勢，但未回吐先前累積的利率緩解。2年期殖利率下跌2個基點至4.18%，5年期與10年期分別持平於4.33%與4.63%，30年期則回落1個基點至5.17%。2s10s曲線趨陡2個基點至45個基點，2s30s利差擴大1個基點至99個基點。與8月4日相比，買盤縮至政策敏感的前端與通膨補償，實質殖利率與長期供給溢價則阻止殖利率再度全面下滑。

本交易日同時消化近期通膨與勞動訊號轉弱，以及Fed更強硬的反應函數。WTI下跌0.73%至$75.22，Brent則在此前連續兩天重挫後近乎持平於$79.45。伊朗與阿曼同意一條擬議中的荷姆茲海峽航線，但範圍更廣的60天安排仍在磋商，胡塞組織的威脅也使實體航運能否恢復正常仍存疑。ADP民間就業僅增加44,000人，低於70,000人的市場共識，前值則修正為95,000人。服務業數據較強，但內部分歧：S&P Global服務業PMI終值為54.6，高於前值51.2與初值53.6；ISM服務業PMI由54.0微升至54.1，仍低於54.5的預測，其中就業指數降至47.4，支付價格指數升至70.3。綜合來看，這些因素支撐2年期美債上漲，並使10年期損益兩平通膨率下跌1個基點，卻不足以促使市場明確延長存續期間。

Fed鷹派訊號擴及不同決策立場，政策行動的條件也更清楚；此時若將能源壓力緩解視為反通膨進程已經完成，代價隨之升高。堪薩斯城聯準銀行總裁 Jeff Schmid 今年沒有投票權，他認為需求與投資強勁，代表目前政策並不具限制性。明尼亞波利斯聯準銀行總裁 Neel Kashkari 是7月3名異議者之一，他主張現在就應開始逐步升息，但9月是否行動仍取決於即將公布的數據。7月支持維持利率不變的Fed理事 Lisa Cook 表示，若反通膨未能很快恢復，她已準備採取行動。因此，一名異議者、一名支持按兵不動的投票者與一名無投票權者，都指向政策可能進一步收緊；不過，2年期收盤水準顯示市場仍相當重視偏弱的就業訊號。

美債近期供給風險降溫，較長期仍有保留。官員維持原有指引，名目附息券與浮動利率票據的發行規模至少未來幾季都將保持穩定，排除立即出現公告衝擊的可能。措辭也從評估未來「增加」發行，改為評估未來「調整」發行，在本季借款需求增至$7,390億之際保留彈性。持續依賴國庫券可壓低近期長天期供給，卻會提高融資結構對政策利率的敏感度，而Fed仍可能升息。30年期殖利率收於5.17%，較1個月前高19個基點，反映財政融資、政策公信力與實質報酬要求之間的矛盾仍未化解。

信用與全球市場證實流動性仍正常，卻沒有形成一致的寬鬆訊號。美國信用債基金大致持平，但超大規模雲端業者持續發債，壓抑流通中債券；一筆擬議中的$22億直接貸款，利差至少達8個百分點。歐洲方面，Pfleiderer完成負債管理融資僅8個月後，債券持有人便著手取得控制權。印度政策利率維持不變後，政府債券前端上漲；中國離岸主權債標售則吸引強勁的長存續期間需求。美元下跌0.20%、黃金上漲3.67%，VIX卻同步回落，顯示即使美債有序收盤，政策與地緣政治避險需求仍未退。

## 美債利率、Fed定價、實質殖利率與曲線結構

本日利率改善集中在2年期。2年期殖利率下跌2個基點，5年期與10年期持平，30年期下跌1個基點；繼週二由曲線中段帶動的牛市趨平後，本日轉為溫和牛市趨陡。週線仍呈現全面緩解，各主要附息券天期殖利率下跌3至4個基點。月線則偏緊：2年期上升4個基點、5年期上升10個基點、10年期上升14個基點，30年期上升19個基點。短期通膨壓力消退的速度，快於市場下修長存續期間不確定性所需的補償。

通膨連結市場的定價清楚呈現這股張力。10年期名目殖利率持平於4.63%，實質殖利率卻上升1個基點至2.41%，損益兩平通膨率則下跌1個基點至2.22%。能源外交仍在邊際壓低預期通膨，市場要求的實質報酬卻反向上升。過去1個月，10年期實質殖利率上升15個基點，損益兩平通膨率則下跌1個基點。存續期間的壓力愈來愈來自實質利率與期限溢價，而非市場預期平均通膨將等幅上升。

美國數據對實質殖利率究竟需要帶來多大緊縮效果，給出相反訊號。ADP民間就業增加44,000人，低於70,000人的市場共識，也較修正後前值95,000人放緩；大型、中型與小型企業的新增人數均轉弱。S&P Global服務業PMI終值由51.2升至54.6，也高於53.6的初值；就業以8個月來最快速度擴張，投入成本通膨則升至14個月高點。ISM服務業數據沒有同樣全面轉強：整體指數由54.0微升至54.1，低於54.5的預測；商業活動升至59.1、新訂單升至57.2，但就業指數回落至萎縮區間的47.4，支付價格指數加速至70.3。這組數據削弱積極預防性緊縮的理據，卻沒有給Fed明確的國內反通膨訊號。民間聘僱轉弱、服務成本居高，因而把前端與實質利率曲線推向不同方向。

Schmid從需求與供給衝擊的交互作用建立鷹派論點。他認為需求與投資仍強，目前政策的限制性不足，也不認同供給驅動的通膨突然升高後會自行消退。在他的框架中，通膨會否延續，部分取決於Fed如何回應，以及市場預期Fed會採取什麼行動。這套機制與當前曲線直接相關：油價下跌可以壓低損益兩平通膨率，但若Fed反應被動，投資人又預期通膨高於目標的時間拉長，實質殖利率與期限溢價仍可能上升。

Kashkari與Cook讓鷹派陣線不再只來自無投票權官員。Kashkari在7月投下異議票後，再度表明偏好升息25個基點，並主張現在開始逐步調整利率；但他仍不確定9月是否行動，後續升息也以通膨持平不降或惡化為條件。Cook的立場更能反映鷹派陣線的廣度，因為她先前支持維持利率不變。她指出，關稅影響、油價下跌與AI相關壓力緩解，都可能使升息不再必要；但她同時警告，通膨連續5年高於目標，已提高薪資與物價壓力延續的風險。

前端反應顯示，擴大的鷹派陣線仍未主導本交易日。2年期殖利率4.18%仍高於3.5%至3.75%的聯邦資金利率目標區間，但即使3位官員先後警告政策限制力道不足，2年期殖利率仍然下跌。較合理的解讀是政策保持有條件的耐心：民間聘僱轉弱、能源通膨下降，降低下一步行動的急迫性；服務成本與官員談話則限制利率緩解的幅度。5年期與10年期殖利率持平，顯示未解壓力已延伸至近期政策決策之外，落在經濟成長韌性、通膨公信力與財政供給交會之處。

美國財政部的再融資溝通降低事件風險，卻未化解上述壓力。財政部維持附息券與浮動利率票據的發行規模，並宣布下週進行總額$1,250億的再融資標售，預計可籌得約$287億新資金。若未來增發，偏重較短天期的原則也未改變。與此同時，措辭由「增加」改為「調整」，加上美國財政部借款諮詢委員會要求保留彈性，使2027財政年度採用不同發行結構的可能性依然存在。30年期期限溢價本週升至1.56%，創2013年以來最高；即使收盤平靜，價格中仍含有可觀的政策與融資不確定性補償。

## 信用、融資與初級市場承接

整體信用市場沒有把利率表現分歧演變成風險事件。LQD下跌0.02%、HYG下跌0.04%、JNK下跌0.08%，總報酬跌幅都很小，顯示整體融資環境仍正常運作。市場未全面上漲，本身也具有訊息。除了前端，美債存續期間幾乎未提供支撐；股市經過四個交易日大漲後，領漲族群也轉弱。因此，信用債投資人仍須區分資金用途、供給集中度、契約條款與再融資依賴程度。

超大規模雲端業者債券仍是投資級市場最明顯的系統性供給壓力。Amazon上月發行$250億債券，迫使投資組合重新配置承接空間；投資人賣出流通中的科技債，為認購新券籌措資金。7月期間，Meta債券利差平均擴大約22個基點，Oracle利差擴大29個基點。這些是產業供給與AI投資報酬疑慮直接造成的現券走勢，並非從上市基金表現推論而來。強健的資產負債表可維持市場准入，但反覆發債會使風險重心從違約機率轉向利差讓利與次級市場消化能力。

最新變化是供給壓力正跨越大西洋。Alphabet已在英鎊與瑞士法郎市場完成大規模首次發債，亦曾進入歐元市場。美國投資級投資組合承接了不成比例的科技業借款，因而造就歐洲市場的估值優勢；若歐洲發行量增加，這項優勢可能削弱。潛在融資需求背後，是一股龐大的實體經濟動能：2026年美國AI投資估計略低於$6,000億，相當於GDP的1.8%；占比預計2027年升至2.5%，2028年再升至2.8%。生產性投資可支撐信用體質與經濟成長，但在相關收入實現前，融資時程仍可能先推動利差擴大。

私募融資管道仍有承接能力，但代價高昂。Ares正牽頭安排一筆擬議中的$22億直接貸款，供MedImpact Holdings收購Medical Card System，定價至少為基準利率加8個百分點。私募信貸遭創紀錄贖回潮擾動後，這筆交易的規模足以成為具有意義的市場重啟訊號；然而，利差也反映承擔收購風險所需的補償。United Launch Alliance另尋求透過真正的私募發行籌措約$5億，以再融資既有債務。這項規劃為Boeing與Lockheed Martin的合資企業提供非公開融資管道，但目前仍無定價或需求結果可判斷成交品質。

Pfleiderer說明，只靠契約彈性、缺乏可持續營運路徑的融資終有極限。持有其2029年到期票據逾80%的債權人，同意透過更全面的重組取得控制權。就在8個月前，公司才以一個移出既有債權人範圍的事業單位作為融資基礎，向Monarch Alternative Capital取得資金並搭配股東貸款，合計籌得1.35億歐元；被稱為公司最強現金產生器的業務，因此脫離原債權人的擔保品範圍。現金持續流失，加上歐洲營建需求疲弱，最終耗盡這筆過渡融資。債券持有人目前已提供約8,700萬歐元新融資，其中包括4,700萬歐元的初始承諾，以維持控制權移轉期間的流動性。

整體而言，市場仍然開放，但分化的融資成本高昂。超大規模雲端業者可在全球發債，其龐大規模卻對次級市場造成可衡量的壓力。大型私募貸款可支應收購，但8個百分點的利差是一道很高的門檻。真正的私募發行可擴大貸款人基礎，但擬議中的交易不能視為市場已完成承接。Pfleiderer被接管則顯示，新資金與資產移轉可以延後失敗，卻會進一步惡化不同債權人類別間的價值分配。基金價格穩定只能說明系統流動性；交易條件與控制權才揭示風險累積之處。

## 全球存續期間、央行與財政傳導

印度是海外政策路徑重新定價最明顯的市場。印度儲備銀行（RBI）一致決議連續第四次會議將附買回利率維持在5.25%，並維持中性立場。5年期政府公債殖利率下跌8個基點，10年期下跌3個基點至6.78%；市場未見吸收流動性的訊號，加上總裁對利率保持耐心，殖利率曲線因而呈現牛市趨陡。市場定價所反映的10月升息機率，由前一日的100%降至65%。這波走勢近期為當地存續期間資產帶來買盤，但不代表印度的輸入性通膨風險已經消失。

RBI的預測說明政策為何附帶條件。RBI將截至3月止年度的通膨預測由5.1%下調至5%，同時把截至2027年3月止年度的成長預測由6.6%上調至6.7%。1月至3月當季經濟成長率達7.8%，而印度約90%的原油仰賴進口。食品與燃料可能進一步推高整體通膨，國內部分地區雨量不足，消費品公司也準備進一步漲價。因此，政策按兵不動的基礎是潛在壓力溫和，且經濟有能力承受供給衝擊，而非需求疲弱。

東南亞顯示油價的通膨傳導仍相當不均。泰國7月CPI年增率由2.42%放緩至1.95%，低於預期；繼6月月減0.34%後，7月再月減0.73%。核心通膨由1.23%微升至1.34%，顯示燃料帶來緩解之餘，國內仍有溫和通膨壓力。菲律賓通膨降至6.2%，低於調查中位數6.4%與6月水準，核心通膨也在6個月來首次放緩。然而，米價上漲17.1%，央行在今年累計升息50個基點後仍準備進一步緊縮，披索上漲0.7%也只能部分緩衝進口成本。

捷克通膨在已開發歐洲殖利率曲線上，也呈現整體與核心分歧。7月CPI為1.7%，連續第二個月低於2%目標，並符合預期。服務通膨由4.5%加速至4.7%，核心通膨先前則接近3%。捷克國家銀行6月升息後，預計本次將利率維持在3.75%；市場仍計入未來1年可能再升息1至2次。原物料壓力下降可以延後行動，但服務價格持續偏高，限制海外存續期間資產僅憑全球能源價格逆轉而上漲的空間。

中國則出現另一種存續期間需求。財政部各發行人民幣10億元的15年期與30年期離岸主權債，殖利率分別為創紀錄低點的1.99%與2.24%。本次各天期合計投標倍數達4.67倍，創2025年6月以來最高。境內10年期殖利率先前已降至1.71%；本次結果顯示，即使美國30年期殖利率仍高於5%，投資人仍願意延長人民幣債券的存續期間。當地承接結果雖然強勁，卻是在與美元存續期間競爭，並非自動支撐後者。

日本與美債買盤基礎的連結更直接。美方對日圓干預的支持轉趨明確，日本財務大臣也確認當局已買進日圓，未來操作可使用FIMA附買回機制。以美債作抵押借入美元，可減少立即直接賣出美債的需求；但單一交易對手每日$600億的上限，已接近近期一次干預的估計規模，而且該機制定價仍以備援用途為準。日本另有估計$1,620億存款，並有國庫券持續到期，因而降低立即賣出長天期附息債券的依賴。這套機制可限制被迫賣出造成的供給，卻無法消除JGB利率走高帶來的相對殖利率挑戰。

全球淨效應是分化，而非同步寬鬆。印度與泰國取得較大政策空間，但菲律賓與捷克仍受國內通膨限制。中國展現對本國主權債存續期間的強勁需求。日本可妥善設計匯率防衛機制，以維持美債市場正常運作；但這也使美國支持日圓走強正式化，並可能削弱美元。外國投資人5月仍持有$9.4兆美債，較1年前增加4%，不支持買方全面退場的說法。然而，外資需求增幅不及美國借款成長，使長天期美債同時面對國內供給與更具競爭力的海外殖利率曲線。

## 新興市場主權債、美元流動性與債務管理風險

新興市場定價有序，但各市場走勢不一。美元指數下跌0.20%之際，EMB下跌0.05%，15年期以上新興市場美元主權債指數則上漲0.30%。長天期指數受惠於美國基準殖利率穩定，仍展現存續期間敏感度；ETF卻未呈現廣泛的風險資產漲勢。匯率與美元條件僅在邊際轉鬆，並未顯示普遍的美元流動性事件。對壓力最大的主權債而言，當地財政公信力與再融資架構仍比共同因子重要。

加彭與塞內加爾顯示，一項制度面進展可迅速拉開原本走勢相近的信用體。1月時，兩國主權債相對美債利差都接近1,000個基點；此後加彭利差收斂至約608個基點，塞內加爾則擴大至1,541個基點。由IMF支持的加彭稽核顯示債務低於原先認知，也提高IMF計畫可在無須重組債務下推進的預期。塞內加爾的稽核反而揭露$70億先前隱匿的借款，重啟一項自2024年起暫停的貸款機制之談判也陷入停滯。兩者分歧反映的是資產負債表公信力與取得計畫融資的能力，而非美元的共同走勢。

加彭把改善的市場觀感轉化為$9.2億、2033年到期的私募融資，但成本高達12.65%，是今年新興市場主權債最高殖利率。目前殖利率已降至約11.5%，仍高於評級相近非洲發行人的10.7%平均水準。投資人年初至今已取得19.5%報酬，隨後獲利了結，使加彭2029年與2031年到期美元債週三表現落後。完整稽核仍未出爐，因此這筆私募雖可緩解短期債務，卻未終結財政疑問。塞內加爾則部分仰賴國內借款持續償債；外部計畫支持仍未明朗，當地市場承接能力因而更顯重要。

天候風險限制油價下跌可把新興市場反通膨擴大到何種程度。逐漸增強的聖嬰現象已迫使秘魯關閉鯷魚漁場，這項漁業正常情況下支撐最高$18億出口；截至8月3日，印度降雨量也較正常水準低12%。歷史分析顯示，一次典型的聖嬰現象可能使菲律賓與印尼通膨增加近2個百分點。因此，就在能源壓力緩解之際，食品、水力發電與外匯收入構成第二條供給傳導管道。貨幣疲弱或財政空間有限的經濟體，即使荷姆茲海峽航運恢復正常，仍可能需要收緊政策。

印尼在成長優於預期之際，財政空間依舊有限。第2季GDP年增5.29%，高於5.14%的預測中位數，但低於第1季5.61%；固定資本形成增加6.87%，政府支出則成長近16%。政府已編列約$15億下半年獎勵措施，並追求6%成長，但GDP 3%的法定赤字上限，以及先前導致印尼盾單季下跌5%的支出疑慮，都限制支持規模。Kazakhstan沒有增加美元存續期間，而是尋求融資幣別分散。政府考慮再發行約$5億熊貓債；5月首次發行CNY34億時，需求超過發行規模2倍，並創中國境內市場BBB級主權發行人最低票息。後續交易仍取決於市場狀況與外部赤字融資需求，但已擴大這個投資級商品出口國可接觸的人民幣買方。美國固定收益市場收盤後，巴西央行如預期降息25個基點至14%，使3月以來累計降息幅度達100個基點。決策委員會一致通過，但沒有提供前瞻指引，並維持後續降息取決於數據；2028年第1季通膨預測為3.2%，目標則為3%。7月上旬通膨年增率已由4.8%放緩至4.52%，但財政刺激、需求強勁與天候風險仍使風險平衡偏向上行。由於公布時間較晚，這項決定沒有影響已完成的美債收盤。印尼受限的刺激、Kazakhstan分散融資幣別與巴西審慎降息，共同印證更廣泛的新興市場格局：本地政策選擇仍受財政公信力、預期與匯率敏感度約束。

## 跨資產

股市表現更像大漲後的暫歇，而非總體經濟衝擊。S&P 500下跌0.17%、Nasdaq 100下跌0.83%、半導體股下跌1.40%；此前整體市場已在四個交易日內增加約$3.7兆市值。VIX仍下跌4.18%至15.81。波動率隨指數小幅下跌而回落，不支持資金融通或經濟成長突然受驚的解讀。弱勢集中在具有長存續期間屬性的科技領漲族群；AI支出增加與後續供給上升，已使這些股票對實質殖利率與執行風險更為敏感。

能源市場確認先前的反通膨動能已趨穩，並未全面逆轉。WTI跌至$75.22，Brent則微升至$79.45。伊朗與阿曼在航線上取得進展，壓抑油價反彈；但60天框架尚未完成，加上胡塞組織再度威脅，仍無法形成明確的正常化訊號。10年期損益兩平通膨率下跌1個基點，方向與WTI收低一致。實質殖利率同步上升1個基點，則說明即使近期能源尾端壓力減輕，名目美債殖利率為何仍可收在平盤。

美元與黃金提供最明顯的保留訊號。即使10年期美債殖利率為4.63%、30年期高於5%，美元指數仍下跌至99.69，黃金則大漲3.67%至$4,245.80。這組走勢顯示，市場尋求防範的是政策不確定性、匯率干預與地緣政治再度惡化，而非單純交易通膨。信用債基金僅小幅下跌，VIX也回落，因此這不像市場全面排斥美國資產。跨資產表現反而顯示，局部的信心風險溢價與正常運作的流動性並存。

## 前瞻市場意義

週五官方就業報告可判斷勞動市場是否真正放緩，或ADP增加44,000人只是單項數據疲弱。非農就業增長廣度、失業率與薪資相關指標必須同步轉弱，前端漲勢才可能演變為市場持續下修預期政策路徑。聘僱疲弱但薪資壓力持續，會使Cook與Schmid對通膨僵固的憂慮依然成立；即使2年期美債續漲，10年期實質殖利率也可能維持高檔。數據強勁將印證Kashkari逐步升息的主張，並對2年至5年期殖利率造成最大上行壓力；數據全面轉弱則只有在目前偏高的服務價格訊號也開始降溫時，才能挑戰已擴大的鷹派陣線。

荷姆茲海峽進程接下來取決於實際執行，而非另一則外交標題。臨時安排正式簽署、航線獲得接受、安全保證到位，以及航運與保險活動恢復正常，才能把目前油價跌勢轉化為持續壓低通膨補償的因素。若航運改善之際，WTI與Brent維持在8月5日收盤水準附近或以下，損益兩平通膨率便可進一步下降，能源進口國承受的政策壓力也會減輕。若因安全、通行費或胡塞組織干擾而破局，並推升兩大原油基準，通膨管道會率先重啟，接著便會檢驗Fed更廣泛的緊縮意願是否也將實質殖利率推高。

下週總額$1,250億的再融資標售，將判斷附息券發行指引不變是否足以抑制長端溢價。若標售結果接近當前市場水準，投資人參與均衡，次級市場殖利率也保持穩定，便可支持5.17%的30年期殖利率已充分補償近期供給的看法。若需大幅讓利、非交易商需求疲弱，或標售後殖利率曲線再度趨陡，焦點將由延後至2027年的調整，轉回當前承接能力。下一次FIMA揭露也提供相關的海外需求檢驗：以擔保方式借入美元並避免賣出美債，可抑制干預的外溢影響；若反覆大規模買進日圓，卻看不到使用備援機制，市場仍會把外匯存底資產變現風險計入10年至30年期曲線。

## Opening Fixed-Income Thesis

The August 5 Treasury close interrupted the prior session's broad rally without reversing its cumulative relief. The 2-year yield fell 2 basis points to 4.18%, the 5- and 10-year yields held at 4.33% and 4.63%, and the 30-year eased 1 basis point to 5.17%. The 2s10s curve steepened 2 basis points to 45 and 2s30s widened 1 basis point to 99. Compared with August 4, the improvement narrowed to the policy-sensitive front end and inflation compensation, while real yields and the long-run supply premium prevented another parallel decline.

The session balanced softer immediate inflation and labor signals against a more forceful Fed reaction function. WTI slipped 0.73% to $75.22 and Brent was nearly unchanged at $79.45 after the preceding two-day collapse. Iran and Oman agreed on a proposed Hormuz shipping route, although a broader 60-day arrangement was still under discussion and Houthi threats kept physical normalization uncertain. ADP private payrolls rose just 44,000, below the 70,000 consensus and a revised 95,000 previously. Services data were firmer but internally mixed: the S&P Global Services PMI was finalized at 54.6, up from 51.2 and above the 53.6 flash reading, while the ISM Services PMI edged to 54.1 from 54.0, below the 54.5 forecast, as employment fell to 47.4 and prices paid rose to 70.3. That mix supported the 2-year rally and a 1-basis-point decline in 10-year breakevens, but not a decisive duration extension.

Fed communication became broader and more conditional, raising the cost of treating energy relief as completed disinflation. Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid, a nonvoter this year, argued that strong demand and investment meant policy was not restrictive. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari, one of the three July dissenters, called for gradual increases now, even as he left September dependent on incoming data. Governor Lisa Cook, who backed the July hold, said she was prepared to act if disinflation did not resume soon. A dissenter, a hold voter and a nonvoter therefore converged on the possibility of tighter policy, although the 2-year close shows that markets gave the softer employment signal meaningful weight.

Treasury supply delivered near-term relief and a longer-horizon qualification. Officials maintained guidance that nominal coupon and floating-rate note sizes should remain steady for at least the next several quarters, removing an immediate announcement shock. The language also shifted from evaluating future increases to evaluating future changes, preserving flexibility as current-quarter borrowing needs rise to $739 billion. Continued reliance on bills contains near-term duration supply but increases sensitivity to a policy rate that the Fed may still raise. The 30-year yield's 5.17% close, 19 basis points above its month-earlier level, reflects that unresolved combination of fiscal financing, policy credibility and required real return.

Credit and global markets confirmed liquidity without offering a uniform easing signal. U.S. credit funds were essentially flat, yet hyperscaler issuance continued to pressure existing bonds and a proposed $2.2 billion direct loan carried a spread of at least 8 percentage points. In Europe, Pfleiderer's bondholders moved toward control only eight months after a liability-management financing. India produced a front-end government-bond rally after an unchanged policy rate, while China's offshore sovereign auction drew strong long-duration demand. The dollar fell 0.20% and gold rose 3.67% even as the VIX declined, leaving a policy and geopolitical hedge visible beneath an orderly Treasury close.

## UST Rates, Fed Pricing, Real Yields, And Curve Structure

The curve concentrated the day's improvement at 2 years. The 2-year yield's 2-basis-point decline contrasted with unchanged 5- and 10-year yields and a 1-basis-point fall at 30 years, producing a modest bull steepening after Tuesday's belly-led bull flattening. Weekly changes still show broad relief, with yields 3 to 4 basis points lower across benchmark coupons. The monthly profile remains the more restrictive one: the 2-year is 4 basis points higher, the 5-year 10 basis points higher, the 10-year 14 basis points higher and the 30-year 19 basis points higher. Near-term inflation pressure has receded faster than the compensation demanded for long-duration uncertainty.

Inflation-linked pricing makes that tension explicit. The 10-year nominal yield was unchanged at 4.63%, but its real yield rose 1 basis point to 2.41% as the breakeven fell 1 basis point to 2.22%. Energy diplomacy therefore continued to lower expected inflation at the margin, while the required real return moved in the opposite direction. Over 1 month, the 10-year real yield is 15 basis points higher and the breakeven 1 basis point lower. The duration burden is increasingly a real-rate and term-premium problem, not a market forecast of a proportionate rise in average inflation.

The U.S. releases supplied opposing information about how much restraint those real yields must deliver. ADP private payrolls increased 44,000, missing the 70,000 consensus and slowing from a revised 95,000, with gains weakening across large, midsized and small firms. S&P Global's final Services PMI rose to 54.6 from 51.2 and exceeded its 53.6 flash estimate; employment expanded at the fastest pace in 8 months, while input-cost inflation reached a 14-month high. ISM Services was less uniformly firm: its headline index edged to 54.1 from 54.0, below the 54.5 forecast, as business activity rose to 59.1 and new orders to 57.2, but employment returned to contraction at 47.4 and prices paid accelerated to 70.3. The combination weakens the case for aggressive preemptive tightening, but it does not give the Fed a clean domestic disinflation signal. Softer private hiring and persistent service costs naturally pull the front end and real-rate curve in different directions.

Schmid framed the hawkish case around the interaction of demand and supply shocks. He judged current policy insufficiently restrictive because demand and investment remained strong, and he rejected the assumption that a burst of supply-driven inflation would fade on its own. In his framework, persistence depends partly on how the Fed responds and on what markets expect it to do. That mechanism is relevant to the current curve: lower oil can compress breakevens, yet a passive reaction function can still raise real yields and term premium if investors expect a longer period of above-target inflation.

Kashkari and Cook widened the coalition beyond that nonvoting signal. Kashkari repeated his preference for a quarter-point increase after dissenting in July and said gradual adjustment should begin now, but he remained unsure about September and made further moves conditional on inflation moving sideways or worsening. Cook's position is more consequential for breadth because she supported the hold. She identified tariff effects, lower oil and easing AI-related pressure as possible reasons a hike could become unnecessary, while warning that five years of above-target inflation increased the risk of persistence in wages and prices.

The front end's response shows that hawkish breadth did not dominate the session. A 2-year yield at 4.18% remains above the 3.5% to 3.75% funds range, but it fell despite three independently timed warnings about insufficient restraint. The cleaner interpretation is conditional patience: weaker private hiring and lower energy inflation reduced the urgency of the next move, whereas service costs and the speakers limited the amount of relief. The unchanged 5- and 10-year yields locate the unresolved burden beyond the immediate policy date, where growth resilience, inflation credibility and fiscal supply overlap.

Treasury's refunding communication reduced event risk without resolving that overlap. The department maintained coupon and floating-rate note sizes and announced $125 billion of refunding auctions for the following week, expected to raise about $28.7 billion of new cash. Its preference for placing any future increases toward shorter maturities was unchanged. At the same time, the shift from increases to changes in its language and the Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee's call for flexibility preserve the possibility of a different issuance profile in fiscal 2027. The 30-year term premium reached 1.56% this week, its highest since 2013, so the quiet close still embeds a substantial price for policy and financing uncertainty.

## Credit, Funding, And Primary-Market Absorption

Broad credit did not turn the mixed rates session into a risk event. LQD fell 0.02%, HYG declined 0.04% and JNK lost 0.08%, small total-return moves that leave aggregate financing conditions functional. The absence of a broad rally is also informative. Treasury duration offered little support beyond the front end, and equity leadership weakened after a large four-day advance. Credit investors consequently had no reason to relax the distinctions already visible across use of proceeds, supply concentration, documentation and refinancing dependence.

Hyperscaler bonds remain the clearest systemic supply pressure inside investment grade. Amazon's $25 billion sale last month forced portfolio capacity decisions as investors sold outstanding technology debt to fund the new issue. During July, Meta bond spreads widened about 22 basis points on average and Oracle spreads widened 29 basis points. Those are direct cash-bond moves tied to sector supply and concern about returns on AI investment, rather than an inference from listed funds. Strong balance sheets preserve access, but repeated issuance transfers more of the risk from default probability to spread concession and secondary-market digestion.

The current delta is that the pressure is becoming transatlantic. Alphabet has already made large debut sales in sterling and Swiss francs and has also used the euro market. More European issuance could erode the valuation advantage that developed as U.S. investment-grade portfolios absorbed a disproportionate share of technology borrowing. The prospective need is underwritten by a large real-economy impulse: estimated U.S. AI investment is just under $600 billion in 2026, or 1.8% of GDP, with the share projected to reach 2.5% in 2027 and 2.8% in 2028. Productive investment can support credit quality and growth, but the funding calendar can still widen spreads before revenues arrive.

Private channels showed capacity at a price. Ares was leading a proposed $2.2 billion direct loan for MedImpact Holdings' acquisition of Medical Card System, with pricing of at least 8 percentage points over the benchmark rate. The size makes it a meaningful reopening signal after record redemptions unsettled private credit, yet the spread shows the compensation required for acquisition risk. United Launch Alliance was separately seeking about $500 million through a true private placement to refinance debt. That planned transaction offers Boeing and Lockheed Martin's joint venture a nonpublic route, but no pricing or demand result had yet established its clearing quality.

Pfleiderer illustrates the limit of financing that relies on documentation flexibility rather than a sustainable operating path. Holders of more than 80% of its 2029 notes agreed to take control through a broader restructuring. Only eight months earlier, the company had raised EUR135 million from Monarch Alternative Capital and a shareholder loan against a unit shifted away from existing creditors, removing the business described as its strongest cash generator from their collateral reach. Continued cash burn and weak European construction demand exhausted that bridge. Bondholders have now provided about EUR87 million of new financing, including EUR47 million of initial commitments, to support liquidity through the transfer.

The aggregate conclusion is open markets with expensive segmentation. Hyperscalers can issue globally, but their volume creates measurable secondary pressure. Large private loans can finance acquisitions, but an 8-percentage-point spread is a substantial hurdle. A true private placement can widen the lender base, but a proposed deal is not yet absorption. Pfleiderer's takeover shows that new money and asset transfers can delay failure while worsening the distribution of value among creditor classes. Stable fund prices therefore describe system liquidity; transaction terms and control rights describe where the risk is accumulating.

## Global Duration, Central Banks, And Fiscal Transmission

India supplied the clearest foreign policy-path repricing. The Reserve Bank of India unanimously held the repo rate at 5.25% for a fourth meeting and retained a neutral stance. Five-year government yields fell 8 basis points and 10-year yields declined 3 basis points to 6.78%, a bull steepening driven by the absence of a liquidity-absorption signal and the governor's patience on rates. Market pricing for an October increase fell to 65% from 100% the previous day. The move offers a near-term local-duration bid, even though it does not imply that India's imported-inflation risk has disappeared.

The RBI's forecasts explain the conditionality. It lowered inflation for the year through March to 5% from 5.1%, while raising growth for the year ending March 2027 to 6.7% from 6.6%. Growth had reached 7.8% in the January-March quarter, and India imports roughly 90% of its crude. Food and fuel could lift headline inflation further, rainfall is deficient in parts of the country, and consumer companies are preparing additional price increases. The policy hold therefore rests on muted underlying pressure and resilience to a supply shock, not on weak demand.

Southeast Asia showed how uneven that oil transmission remains. Thailand's July CPI slowed to 1.95% from 2.42%, below expectations, and fell 0.73% on the month after a 0.34% decline in June. Core inflation edged up to 1.34% from 1.23%, preserving a mild domestic qualification to the fuel-led relief. Philippine inflation eased to 6.2%, below the 6.4% survey median and June rate, and core inflation slowed for the first time in six months. Yet rice prices rose 17.1%, the central bank remained prepared to tighten after 50 basis points of increases this year, and the peso's 0.7% gain supplied only a partial import-cost cushion.

Czech inflation delivered the same headline-core split in a developed European curve. July CPI was 1.7%, below the 2% target for a second month and in line with expectations. Services inflation accelerated to 4.7% from 4.5%, and core inflation had been near 3%. The Czech National Bank was expected to hold at 3.75% after its June increase, with markets still allowing one to two additional hikes over a year. Lower commodity pressure can delay action, but persistent service prices limit how much foreign duration can rally on the global energy reversal alone.

China provided a different form of duration demand. The Ministry of Finance sold CNY1 billion each of 15- and 30-year offshore sovereign bonds at record-low yields of 1.99% and 2.24%. Across maturities, the auction achieved a 4.67 bid-to-cover ratio, the highest since June 2025. The result follows a decline in the onshore 10-year yield to 1.71% and shows that investors were willing to extend yuan duration even as U.S. long yields remained above 5% at 30 years. It is a strong local absorption result, though it competes with rather than automatically supports dollar duration.

Japan remains the more direct link to the Treasury buyer base. Washington's support for yen intervention became more explicit, and Japan's finance minister confirmed that authorities had bought yen and could use the FIMA repo facility in future operations. Borrowing dollars against Treasuries can reduce immediate outright sales, but the $60 billion daily counterparty cap is close to the estimated scale of one recent intervention and the facility is priced as a backstop. Japan also has an estimated $162 billion in deposits and recurring Treasury-bill maturities, reducing reliance on immediate long-coupon sales. The mechanism contains forced supply without eliminating the relative-yield challenge from higher JGB rates.

The net global impulse is dispersion rather than synchronized easing. India and Thailand gained policy room, but the Philippines and Czech Republic retained domestic inflation constraints. China demonstrated strong demand for its own sovereign duration. Japan's currency defense can be structured to protect Treasury market functioning, yet it also formalizes U.S. support for a stronger yen and may weaken the dollar. Foreign investors still held $9.4 trillion of Treasuries in May, 4% more than a year earlier, which argues against a broad buyer strike. Their demand has not kept pace with U.S. borrowing growth, leaving long Treasuries exposed to both domestic supply and more competitive foreign curves.

## EM Sovereigns, Dollar Liquidity, And Debt-Management Risk

Emerging-market pricing was orderly but internally inconsistent. EMB slipped 0.05% as the Dollar Index fell 0.20%, while the 15-year-plus EM dollar sovereign index gained 0.30%. The long index benefited from stable U.S. benchmark yields and retained duration sensitivity, whereas the ETF did not show a broad risk rally. Currency conditions were easier at the margin, not indicative of a generalized dollar-liquidity event. Local fiscal credibility and refinancing architecture therefore remained more important than the common factor for the most stressed sovereigns.

Gabon and Senegal show how quickly an institutional update can separate credits that once traded together. Both sovereigns carried spreads near 1,000 basis points over Treasuries in January. Gabon's spread has since narrowed to about 608 basis points, while Senegal's has widened to 1,541 basis points. Gabon's IMF-supported audit indicated lower debt and raised expectations that an IMF program could proceed without restructuring. Senegal's audit instead uncovered $7 billion of previously hidden borrowing, and talks to revive a lending facility suspended since 2024 have stalled. The divergence reflects balance-sheet credibility and program access, not a common move in the dollar.

Gabon converted that improved narrative into $920 million of private-placement funding due in 2033, but paid 12.65%, the highest EM sovereign yield this year. The yield has fallen to about 11.5%, still above the 10.7% average for similarly rated African issuers. Its 2029 and 2031 dollar bonds then lagged on Wednesday as investors took profit after a 19.5% year-to-date return. The full audit remains pending, so the placement relieves short-term obligations without closing the fiscal question. Senegal continues to meet payments partly through domestic borrowing, increasing the importance of local-market capacity as external program support remains unresolved.

Weather risk limits how far lower oil can broaden EM disinflation. A strengthening El Nino has already closed Peru's anchovy fishery, which normally supports exports worth as much as $1.8 billion, and Indian rainfall through August 3 was 12% below normal. Historical analysis indicates that a typical episode can add nearly 2 percentage points to inflation in the Philippines and Indonesia. Food, hydropower and external receipts therefore create a second supply channel just as energy pressure eases. Economies with weak currencies or limited fiscal space may still need tighter policy even if Hormuz shipping normalizes.

Indonesia combined better growth with a narrow fiscal margin. Q2 GDP rose 5.29% from a year earlier, above the 5.14% median forecast but below Q1's 5.61%, as fixed investment increased 6.87% and government spending almost 16%. The government had earmarked about $1.5 billion of second-half incentives while seeking 6% growth, yet the statutory deficit ceiling of 3% of GDP and scrutiny that had contributed to a 5% quarterly rupiah decline constrained the scale of support. Kazakhstan pursued funding diversification rather than additional dollar duration. The government was considering about $500 million of panda bonds after a CNY3.4 billion debut in May attracted more than twice the offered amount and achieved the lowest coupon for a BBB-rated sovereign in China's onshore market. A follow-on deal remained conditional on market conditions and external deficit-financing needs, but it broadened the yuan investor base available to an investment-grade commodity exporter. After the U.S. fixed-income close, Brazil's central bank delivered an expected 25-basis-point cut to 14%, taking cumulative easing since March to 100 basis points. The unanimous board withheld forward guidance and kept the cycle dependent on data, with 2028 Q1 inflation forecast at 3.2% against a 3% target. Annual inflation had slowed to 4.52% in early July from 4.8%, but fiscal stimulus, strong demand and weather risk kept the balance tilted upward. The timing means the decision did not shape the completed Treasury close. Together, Indonesia's bounded stimulus, Kazakhstan's currency diversification and Brazil's cautious cut reinforce the broader EM pattern of local policy choices constrained by fiscal credibility, expectations and currency sensitivity.

## Cross asset

Equities looked more like a pause after a large rally than a macro shock. The S&P 500 fell 0.17%, the Nasdaq 100 declined 0.83% and semiconductors lost 1.40% after the broader market had added about $3.7 trillion over four sessions. The VIX nevertheless dropped 4.18% to 15.81. Falling volatility alongside modest index losses argues against an abrupt funding or growth scare. The weakness was concentrated in long-duration technology leadership, where higher AI spending and future supply had already increased sensitivity to both real yields and execution risk.

Energy confirmed that the prior disinflation impulse stabilized rather than fully reversed. WTI fell to $75.22, while Brent edged up to $79.45. Progress on an Iran-Oman shipping route limited the rebound, but the uncompleted 60-day framework and renewed Houthi threat prevented a clean normalization signal. The 1-basis-point decline in 10-year breakevens is directionally aligned with the lower WTI close. The simultaneous 1-basis-point increase in the real yield shows why nominal Treasuries could finish unchanged even as the immediate energy tail eased.

The dollar and gold supplied the strongest qualification. The Dollar Index fell to 99.69 despite a 10-year Treasury yield of 4.63% and a 30-year yield above 5%, while gold jumped 3.67% to $4,245.80. That combination points to demand for protection against policy uncertainty, currency intervention and geopolitical relapse rather than a simple inflation trade. Credit funds were only marginally lower and the VIX fell, so the move did not resemble a wholesale rejection of U.S. assets. Cross assets instead describe a narrow confidence premium coexisting with functional liquidity.

## Forward Market Significance

Friday's government employment report separates a genuine labor slowdown from ADP's 44,000 increase. Payroll breadth, unemployment and wage-sensitive measures need to soften together for the front-end rally to become a durable reduction in the expected policy path. Weak hiring with persistent wage pressure would leave Cook's and Schmid's concern about inflation persistence intact and could keep the 10-year real yield elevated even if the 2-year rallies. A firm report would validate Kashkari's call for gradual increases and should place the greatest pressure on 2- to 5-year yields; a broad softening would challenge the enlarged hawkish coalition only if the elevated service-price evidence also begins to cool.

The Hormuz process now depends on physical implementation rather than another diplomatic headline. A signed interim arrangement, an accepted route, security guarantees and normalizing shipping and insurance activity would turn the current oil decline into a more durable input for inflation compensation. WTI and Brent remaining near or below their August 5 closes as traffic improves would allow breakevens to extend lower and reduce the policy burden on energy importers. A breakdown over security, tolls or Houthi disruption that lifts both crude benchmarks would reopen the inflation channel first, then test whether the Fed's broader willingness to tighten pushes real yields higher as well.

Next week's $125 billion refunding auctions determine whether steady coupon guidance is enough to contain the long-end premium. Clearing near prevailing market levels with balanced investor participation and stable secondary yields would support the view that the 5.17% long bond already compensates for near-term supply. Material concessions, weak nondealer demand or renewed post-auction steepening would shift attention from deferred 2027 changes to current absorption. The next FIMA disclosure adds a related foreign-demand check: collateralized dollar borrowing that avoids Treasury sales would contain intervention spillover, whereas repeated large yen operations without visible backstop use would keep reserve liquidation risk embedded in the 10- to 30-year curve.
